protocol.claim_boundary: analysis of existing fixed-weight state traces; descriptive geometry and channel relations only, with no causal, routing, memory-use, learning, adaptation, or architecture claim
comparison_families: within-order cue6 to delay2/delay8/delay32/delay64 for train and heldout orders
cross-order train to heldout at matched checkpoints
controls_and_limits: The same full history identities are paired in every reported comparison.
Cross-channel change-norm correlations are descriptive co-change statistics, not directional or causal effects.
Eight parameter seeds are the independent units across two separately allocated four-seed batches; timepoints, orders, and channel pairs are dependent within a seed.
No threshold promotes H-UNC-001. Candidate patterns require a fresh preregistered confirmation before causal interpretation.
protocol.falsifier: No reproducible candidate pattern appears across both batches; report heterogeneity rather than selecting a best seed or timepoint.
protocol.history_pairing: Within each seed/order/checkpoint cell, sort all 64 full histories by public binary symbols. Require identical history lists in every paired comparison.

relations: per-history gate-state change norm correlated with each non-gate channel change norm over each cue6-to-delay interval

protocol.state_source: E-UNC-013 and E-UNC-014 immutable matrix artifacts; no trajectories are newly generated
